objective: Keep the current workspace intact when a newly loaded dataset has no usable or decodable image stream.

transaction_order: select the restored topic when valid, otherwise the first image topic
only then archive the old session and activate the new dataset
behavior.success_feedback: file manager shows the verified first-frame resolution
behavior.failure_feedback: explicit compatibility error and current dataset remains active

rejection_acceptance.input: synthetic indexed MCAP containing only an odometry topic
rejection_acceptance.error: 该文件没有可用的图像话题，当前数据保持不变

limitations: The 67 MB CVAT file is a materially different one-topic compressed-image container, but it may still originate from related factory imagery; this is format and workflow compatibility evidence, not independent semantic generalization evidence.
Only the selected topic's first frame is probed at activation. Later isolated corruption remains covered by per-frame failures and exact retry.
No formal workspace dataset was switched during acceptance; the real CVAT load ran in an isolated temporary work directory.
